name: mcp-inspector
description: A local, no-login tool for listing and calling tools on any MCP server (Streamable HTTP or stdio), the non-tools/call protocol methods, and (optionally) PingOne's hosted MCP server.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix server & npm run dev --prefix web
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix web && npm start --prefix server
